assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The patient has a diagnosis of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R42.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229.
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the patient's concerning symptoms for potential arrhythmia.
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to service delivery.
The claim was denied under reason code CO-197.
The required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to service delivery, resulting in the denial under reason code CO-197.
